_comment: This game's revisions of the starter and structure decks (data/decks.json keeps them as printed), by set code: `copies` copies (default all) of the card named `out` become `in`, in the same slot (number and rarity), like a reprint. Each says why. Applied by tools/data/build-data.mjs to public/data/decks.json, the lists the shops show and sell; smoke checks every deck is legal.

SDY.why: 1 Forbidden card per deck: the four starters all keep Change of Heart (owner's pick); Kuriboh is Yugi's own, a weak card for the strongest starter.
Starter nerf, the same in all four (owner's pick): Premature Burial costs 800 LP and the monster dies with it.
Starter nerf, the same in all four (owner's pick): Hammer Shot destroys only the strongest Attack Position monster, maybe your own.

SDP.why: 1 Forbidden card per deck: the four starters all keep Change of Heart (owner's pick); Toon Table of Contents fetches the deck's only Toon World.
Gryphon Wing only answers Harpie's Feather Duster, which is Forbidden (owner's pick for evening out the starters).
Evening out the starters (owner's pick): Pegasus won 30%; the Scout's Flip draws the opponent 3 cards, Toon Gemini Elf is a 1900 ATK Level 4.

SYE.why: 1 Forbidden card per deck: keeps Change of Heart, like the starters (owner's OK); Jar of Greed draws too.
1 Forbidden card per deck (owner's OK); Thousand Knives is Dark Magician support, the deck's ace.

SD1.why: Nobleman of Crossout is Limited; Smashing Ground does the same job, 1-for-1 monster removal (owner's OK).

SD6.why: Magician of Faith is Limited; Old Vindictive Magician is another Flip Spellcaster, it destroys a monster (owner's OK).
